versions.changelog:
- Initial release of **study-workbench** skill: a template engine for generating daily student study dashboards based on course progress.
- Supports one-step creation of single-file HTML study desks (lesson scheduling, daily knowledge, practice, accumulation, review, exam countdown), defaulting to 8th grade Chinese/Math/English (Renjiao 2024).
- Engine and content-pack separation: replaceable JSON packs allow rapid adaptation to any grade/subject/version.
- All logic and assets are local (no external dependencies or CDNs), supporting both PC and mobile with localStorage data persistence.
- Clear usage flow for default deployment and content pack customization, with built-in compliance checks for best practices.
